name: giftmaxxing-api
description: Giftmaxxing API. Runs on Lambda (handler.handler) AND as a container on App Runner (server.mjs -> handler). The nodejs20.x Lambda runtime provides client-dynamodb + lib-dynamodb, but a plain Node container does NOT, so they are listed here too; harmless on Lambda (bundled copy used).
